summary.oneLiner: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.

one-line thesis: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.
guidance / outlook: Guiding for at least 50% revenue growth in FY27; expanding retail footprint (FOFO/COCO), modern trade, quick commerce, and Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027)
order book & pipeline: n/a (B2C brand with no order book)
segment / subsidiary detail: FY26 revenue mix: Online Sales 43.87% (72% direct website/app), FOFO Stores 24.50%, B2B 30.73%, COCO Stores 0.91%. 350+ SKUs across 5 categories: Eye, Face, Lip, Body, Accessories.
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into modern trade and quick commerce; potential international rollout; private label development for B2B; Ludhiana warehouse (Apr 2027) enabling regional scale
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin improved from 46.1% (FY25) to 106.3% (FY26) due to asset-light model, better marketing efficiency, and SKU mix optimization; gross margin improved from ~54% (FY25) to ~60% (FY26) based on revenue and COGS trends
capex / expansion: Capex primarily for retail stores and warehouse: FOFO/COCO expansion ongoing; Ludhiana warehouse capex expected to commence Apr 2027; no major capex disclosed for FY26
capital allocation: IPO proceeds allocated to working capital, retail expansion (FOFO/COCO), modern trade/quick commerce penetration, and supply chain (Ludhiana warehouse); no dividends or buybacks mentioned
risks & watch-items: Intense competition from established players (L'Oréal, Nykaa, Mamaearth); inflationary pressure on raw materials; reliance on digital marketing for CAC; execution risk in rapid retail expansion; regulatory changes in e-commerce or cosmetics labeling
non-obvious takeaways: 72% of online sales are direct via own app/website — rare for Indian DTC beauty brands, indicating strong brand loyalty and low platform dependency; 500+ masterclasses conducted build institutional credibility beyond retail
